Only Sam turns this off (set false here, or KF_FREE_ONLY=0 in the workflow env).

procedural.note: the free procedural score engine (another agent is building it). Called with the job folder and the output mp3; it reads ad.json prep.music and cues the length from audio/vo.json. If it is missing, sound.py lays a quiet placeholder pad (films/director/pad.py) so the film can still be finished and checked.
